purpose: Relate the measured run to the reviewer-facing recipe without rewriting historical provenance.

equivalence.description: The measured batch256 and non-thinking command and the delivered default command produce the same Hydra overrides. The delivered script changes where those values are specified, adds fail-fast topology checks, and leaves the training implementation unchanged.
equivalence.data_check_change: Assertions were replaced with explicit errors so validation remains active under Python optimization. The successful-input transformation is unchanged.

limitations: These changes were validated offline and did not rerun NPU training.
The measured run identity and file hashes remain authoritative for the published training result.
External review, CI approval and maintainer acceptance are separate from this local verification.
